subject: where market.561.group runs first
facts: The Google Cloud project five-six-one-group-dev has billing disabled (gcloud billing projects describe, 2026-09-11): Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, and Secret Manager refuse, so no new image can be built or deployed to Cloud Run; the paid-ephemeris-gateway service still runs on its 2026-08-15 image.

This machine holds a Cloudflare OAuth login for wrangler (account 337e54ee6dc7d488933f473204a6d89e) and a wrangler binary; the five retired sellers' Workers (paid-pacing-intelligence-gateway, paid-value-chain-gateway, paid-orphan-patch-triage-gateway, base-chain-data-gateway, 561-group-market-site) still exist.

The market engine already has a Workers face (createMarketWorker); the two DE440 precision offers shell out to the pinned oxieph binary and need a Node host; every other offer runs on a fetch-handler host.
decision: Serve market.561.group from the edge face (apps/market-561-group/src/worker.mjs, wrangler.jsonc) now, with every offer not declared runtime node; the two precision offers are unsold until the Node runner has a public host.
Keep the Node runner's Cloud Run carrier (lib/cloud-run) ready; it deploys the whole catalog the day billing is enabled on the project or another Node host is chosen.

Retire the five Workers and the ephemeris Cloud Run service and its ephemeris.561.group domain mapping only after the edge face answers live 402 challenges on market.561.group for the catalog's routes.
Use PayAI's keyless facilitator on the edge face (as the retired Workers did); the CDP facilitator stays the Node runner's, where its secrets live.
askOfTheFounder: Enable billing on five-six-one-group-dev (or name another Node host) so the Node runner and the precision offers go live; nothing else in this decision needs a human hand.

furtherDecisions.subject: the HBD rail (x402-hive-exit-tightness-seller-service)
facts: The house HBD scheme is an x402 v1-shaped, memo-addressed hbd-transfer flow verified against two public Hive nodes (x402-hbd-scheme-service: form, verify, settle); it has no x402 v2 client scheme, so no buyer agent can pay it through a v2 challenge today.
x402-hive-exit-tightness-seller-service is one exported operation (sellHiveExitTightnessResource) with no transport, domain, or runner of its own; there is nothing of it to retire.
No settlement in HBD has ever been witnessed for it; the pool's Hive settlement is a separate program (pool-service).
decision: The market gains a second scheme (an in-process hive:mainnet facilitator over x402-hbd-scheme-service's verify and settle, and a SchemeNetworkServer for the hbd-transfer price) the day a buyer-side x402 v2 client scheme for HBD exists or a buyer asks; until then the market settles only the exact EVM scheme.
x402-hive-exit-tightness-seller-service stays as the library it already is, pinned to x402-hbd-scheme-service 0.2.0; it is not a catalog entry and is not counted as a per-compute runner.
This closes the finding 2026-09-11-finding-x402-hive-exit-tightness-seller-service-not-yet-foldable.json as decided, not deferred.
